subject.title: fix(github-copilot): add timeout to embedding model discovery

question: Should GitHub Copilot embedding model discovery fail fast after 30 seconds through the existing guarded-fetch timeout?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but the deadline changes slow-endpoint behavior for existing Copilot embedding setups and should be an intentional provider policy.

options.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
options.body: Land the bounded discovery request as the provider-local fail-fast policy, consistent with recent provider timeout hardening.

options.title: Tune the deadline before merge
options.body: Ask for a different constant or owner-approved rationale if 30 seconds is too aggressive for Copilot `/models` discovery.

options.title: Pause for provider-owner review
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want broader Copilot setup-timeout policy reviewed before accepting fail-fast behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
recommendation.body: Land the bounded discovery request as the provider-local fail-fast policy, consistent with recent provider timeout hardening.
